name: cr611_2c_ghost_vacuum_returns_what_it_exiled_as_flying_spirits
why: CR 611.2c, 122.6, 613.4b: sacrificed, Ghost Vacuum still knows what it exiled: the creature card, an opponent's too, comes back under its controller's control with a flying counter as a 1/1; its Island stays, and so does a creature it didn't exile.
expect_order: Grizzly Bears is moved to exile
moves Grizzly Bears to the battlefield
Grizzly Bears enters with a Flying counter
Grizzly Bears becomes a Spirit in addition to its other types
Grizzly Bears deals 1 damage to Player B
